channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Fourth of July with fireworks and America 250 events at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with family activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Juno Beach residents push for fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as budget talks loom
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons. The dispute will be taken up during budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman killed in home fire as community rallies around fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city chosen for the honor this year.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire, friends rally to support surviving fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the Hobe Sound home she shared with her fiance. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.
